translation.name: Bab dummad Jesucristoba igar mesisad garda

content: Yar-mullugi Jesús sogsad, doamargi bur nued binsalesa
Jesús dulemar-bukidar ese duurmakdani dakdegu, yar-birse nakwisad. Agi sigisgu, e-sapingan ese nonimalad.
Degi, Jesús dulemar-odurdakdegu, sogded:

content.text: degi, uku-uku itodimalad, amargi nued binsalesad,
ar Bab Dummad nabir igar-inikigwad-imaked amar-imakoed

content: “Dulemar an-nug-ular be-ichoarmalar, be-bareginnarmalar, degi, galagwensuli binsa gakansaar begi sunmakarmalar, bemargi nued binsalesdo.
Bemar yeer itomar, wergumar, ar nibneggi bemarga ibmar-uklegoed dummarbad, ar ayobi Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba-berbemalad epenne bemar-idu baregillesmarmogad.”
Bemar we-napneggined baluyob gumalad
Jesús sogdebar: “Bemar we-napneggi baluyob gumalad. Ar balu-e-gaibid surgudele, ¿igi bar balu-balu guosunna? Geg bar ib-nuedga gued, degisoggu, balu igargi-mier bur nabirid, dulemar egi annaegar.”
Bemar gwallu-meegwadyob gumalad
Jesús sogdebar: “Bemar we-napneggi gwallu-meegwadga gumalad, ar neggwebur-gwagwen yar-birgi siile, geg we-neggwebur dukued.
Degine, gwallu, ulu-urba-siega ogalesulid, gwallu ogaleged, e-sied-birgi siegar, adi bela dulemar-neg-yagi-bukmaladga neg-mee-saegar.
Debayobi, gwallu gaeyobi, bemar dulemar-asabin damarmo, adi dule-baigan be-dakmalagar, bemar ibmar-nuegan imakdiid, degine, adi be Bab-Dummad-nibneggi-maid-e-nug ogannomalagar.”
Moisés-igar-mesisadba daegala Jesús nonikid
Jesús sogdebar: “Mer be binsamalo, Moisés-igar-mesisad, igi, Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba-berbemalad-igar-mesisad osulogega an noniye. Suli, an aga nonisulid, an nonikidi a-igar gatik bur-nue odulogegar.
“Ar napira an bemarga sogmalad, we-napneg, degi, nibneg-naid bergued-idu, Moisés-igar-narmakar-naid e-bichugwad-bur-bipigwad gwen bipisaar wis ogwalegosulid, ar bela narmakar-naidba guedsegad.

Degisoggu, ar doa-dule we-igar-maidgi wis bipisaar egi gwatirisale, degine, ar deyob dulemar-odurdakele, a-dule, dule-bipigwadye nibneggi bilegoed. Ar dule bela Moisés-igar-maidba daele, degine, ar deyob dulemar-odurdakbalile, we-dule, dule-dummadye Bab-Dummad-neg-dakmaidgi bilemogoed.
“Ar napira an bemarga sogmalad, bemar igar-napiragwad-imaked, escribamarba, degi, Fariseomarba bur nuedsulile, Bab-Dummad-neg-dakmaidse bemar gwen dogosurmalad.”
Urwed-igargi Jesús sunmaksad
Degi Jesús sogdebar: “Be itosmalad, epenne igi serganga sogles-gusa:

Ar andi an bemarga sogmalad, ar dule-wargwen binsarsunna sae-itoge e-gwenadse urwe-dibe, a-dulega igar-itoleged megoed. Ar doa-dule e-gwenadga sog-dibe, ‘Be gegegwa an be-dakye,’ a-dulega Judio-dummagan igar-itogoed, ega igar amiegar. Ar doa-dule e-gwenadga sog-dibe, ‘Be akargubi an be-dakye,’ a-dule soo-sailase odurdakleged bur-nabirid.
“Degisoggu, Bab Dummadga ibmar be uksokalid, na e-ukleged-galuse be sedanikir, agi be insaalir, be-gwenadgi be gwatirisad,
be ibmar-Bab-Dummadga-be-uksokalid, na e-ukleged-galugi be obes nae, be-gwenad-bebo igar be nabonagwer, geb degi a-sorba gannar be dagoed, be Bab-Dummadga-ibmar-uksokalid geb be ukoed.

“Dule-bebo igar gwatirnaid, ebo amba be igarba nadapi, gwae agi ebo igar be naboge, ar degi be imaksulile, abakalegi dule igar-naboged-dummadga be-ukalile, degi, a-dule, suar-ibedga be-ukarmogale, degiir, a eskaryagi be-metoed.
Napira an bega soge, be eskaryagi mellesiid, be noosurguodo, bela begi-mani-galesad be bennukedse.”
Abirgunagwarsuli-nanamalad-igargi Jesús sunmaksad
Jesús sogdebar: “Ar be itosmalad igi serganga soglesa:
Ar andi an sogdo, ar dule-wargwen ome-wargwengi sunnasur na e-ulubgi egi binsasale, bato we-dule na abirgunagwarsuli neg-sichigi omegi yolesdo.
Degisoggu, be-ibya-nuedsikid, be-gwage ichogega be-imak-dibe, bur be onodo, bikiin be metedo, ar bur nabirsursi unnila be-sangi-akanaid gwensak bei yoggusar, bur be-san bela soo-sailagi mellegedba.
Ar be-argan-nued be-gwage ichogega be-imak-dibe, bur be sikdo, bikiin be metedo, ar bur nabirsursi unnila be-sangi-akanaid gwensak bei yoggusar, bur be-san bela soo-sailagi mellegedbar.”
Jesús ome-meted-igargi sunmaksad
Jesús sogdebar: “Bemar itosmar igi epenne bemar-serganga soglesbali:

Ar andi an sogdo, ar dule-wargwen unnila e-ome egi-dikarba nosarbi sunna ome-meted. Ar degisulile, ome-meted ega igar gwen maisulid. Ar dule ome-metele, degiir ome neg-sichigi yolega imako-itole, degine, dule ome-melleded nikusale, a-dule ome-dikarba neg-sichigi yoledimodo.”
Mer ibmar-nug be gamar oyogegar, an ibmar imakoye
Degine, bemar itosbar, igi epenne bemar-serganga soglesbali:

content.text: Ar Bab-Dummad-asabin napira be ibmar sogsad,

content: Ar andi an sogdo, mer bipisaar be sogo, an napira imakoye we-nibneg-naid-ularye, ar ade nibneg Bab-Dummad-siged-olo-ganad.

Degine, mer be sogbalo, we-napneg-naid-ular napira an sogye an imakoye, ar ade napneg Bab-Dummad-e-nag-onakwed-ganad. Degine, mer be sogbalo, Jerusalén-neggwebur-ular an napira sogye an imakoye, ar ade Jerusalén Bab-Dummad-e-neggwebur gued.
Degi, be nonose-bakar mer egi be sogo, an-nono-ular an napira ibmar imakoye, ar geg be sailagia-wargwensaar sipuu, igi, sichii be imaked.
“Ar be-sunmaked unnila be soge, eyeye, an imakoye, igi, an sao surye. Ar we-sogedba bur-bule be sogsale, agi ibmar-iskana dani-daed.”
Jesús sogsa-gusad, be-istarmalad be sabgumarye
Jesús sogdebar: “Ar bemar itosmarbalid, epenne be-serganga soglesad:
Ar andi an sogdo: Dule-iskana-abin mer be gwisgu. Bur be imakdo, dule-wargwen be-wagar-nuedsikid bei bibyosale, baid-wagar ega be oyobardo.
Ar dule-wargwen igar-nika igar-maidgi abin-abin be imakar-dibe, bei mor subiguar-dibe, ega be suba ukbardo.
Ar dule-wargwen ise-barmiar milla-gwen ega-ibmar-sedbi be abe-dibe, ega milla-bo ibmar-seded be sae.
Ar dule bese ibmar egichialir, ega be uke. Dulegi mer be ibmar nallegu, dule bega sokalir, wis anga be udagwerye, an gannar bega ukbaloye.”
Jesús sogdebar: “Ar bemar itosmalad epenne be-serganga soglesad:

Ar andi an sogdo: Be-istarmalad be sabgumar, dulemar-be-ukabsadimalad be nued egi binsamar, ibmar-nued ega be imakmar. Dulemar-be-nug-ichodimaladga, degi, be-baregindimaladga Bab Dummadse ega be gormar.

Adi bemar, be-Bab-nibneggi-maid-e-mimmiganga gumalagar, ar Bab Dummaddi bela dulemar-nuegan, degi, dulemar-iskanaga dad-ibeler ogamaid. Degine, Bab Dummad bela dulemar igar-inikii-imakmaladga, degi, igar-inikii-imaksurmaladga di-owimaibalid.
“Ar dule-be-sabmaladbi be sabguele, ¿ar ibu-nued egi be amiosunna? Ibmar-nued egi be amiosuli. ¿Ar dulemar-iskana, Roma-dummadga-mani-gaedgi-arbamalad deyob na imakmosursi?
¿Ar be-gwenadganbi ega be soger, ‘Be nued sogeye,’ ar ibu baiganba bur-nued be imakmarsunna? Bur-nued be imaksuli. ¿Ar deyob dulemar-Bab-Dummad-wichurmalad imakmosursi? Eye, deyob imakmarmoga.
Ar be-Bab-nibneggi-maid dule-nueganga, degi, dule-iskanaganga ibmar-nuegan imaksoggu, a-ular bemar ulubgi dule-nueganga gumarmosundo.”
